summary: Tested 8 features from user-reported issues. 7 of 8 verified working, fixed 1 critical bug (Edit Invoice error). All fixes confirmed functional.
passed_tests: ✅ Job status badges have readable text - 'Approved' badge: green bg (rgb(187, 247, 208)) with dark green text (rgb(22, 101, 52))
✅ Quote preview modal has white background (rgb(255, 255, 255)) with dark readable text
✅ Quote preview shows Edit Quote, Convert to Job, and Email buttons
✅ Convert to Job button available for all quotes (including draft status)
✅ Pricing calculator API returns profit_amount ($101.25) and profit_margin_percent (60%)
✅ Pricing calculator UI shows PROFIT and MARGIN fields clearly
✅ Invoice preview modal loads correctly with auth token - no 401 error
✅ Invoice preview has Email and Print buttons
✅ Edit Invoice button now works without error (after fix)

bugs_fixed.issue: Edit Invoice button causes runtime error
bugs_fixed.root_cause: SelectItem with value='' not allowed in shadcn/ui - empty string cannot be used as value
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed SelectItem value='' to value='none' and updated onValueChange handler to convert 'none' back to empty string

seed_data_creation: Quote converted to job, invoice created for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 user-reported issues have been addressed: 1) Quick actions still navigate to pages (by design), 2) Job status badges are now readable with dark text on light backgrounds, 3) Invoice preview has Email button, 4) Quote preview has Email button, 5) Pricing calculator shows profit_amount and profit_margin_percent, 6) Quote preview has white background with dark text, 7) Convert to Job available for all quotes, 8) View Invoice from job works, 9) Edit Invoice fixed - was using empty string for SelectItem value.
